topography.project_purpose: DCA Tools. Structurally: 131 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 22 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradeabilityproxy, proxy, cdelegatorinterface). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
